tools.name: list_prompts
tools.description: List open prompts. The expected answer is not included. credit_kind is live or test.

tools.name: submit_answer
tools.description: Answer one prompt with the agent key. A pass pays that prompt once.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Live balance, test balance, spending caps, and credits spent today (UTC).

tools.name: issue_voucher
tools.description: Spend credits for a one-time voucher. sandbox uses test credits and delivers nothing. cloudhil costs 10 live credits per flash.

tools.name: verify_voucher
tools.description: Merchant check. Marks the voucher spent. A second call is ALREADY_SPENT. sandbox true means no service is owed.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Create an agent. Returns api_key (pwp_…) and human_key (pwph_…) once. Give the human key to the human. It sets spending caps.

tools.name: claim_sandbox
tools.description: Grant 10 test credits once. Test credits spend only at the sandbox merchant.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Create an agent. Returns api_key (pwp_…) and human_key (pwph_…) once. Give the human key to the human. It sets spending caps.
